title: Zesty Molten Norwegian Chinese Long Beans Skillet
description: A winey and molten Norwegian dish featuring Chinese long beans, perfect for a date night, with a katsuramuki-cut and low-fat-friendly ingredients.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the garlic and ginger and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add the Chinese long beans and cook for 3 minutes, until they start to soften.
Add the white wine, chicken broth, soy sauce, salt, and black pepper, and stir to combine.
Bring the mixture to a simmer and cook for 5 minutes, until the sauce has thickened and the beans are tender.
Reduce the heat to low and let the skillet simmer for 2 minutes, until the sauce is molten and slightly caramelized.
Serve the skillet hot, garnished with sliced green onions and sesame seeds if desired.
Let the dish rest for 1 minute before serving.
Ensure poultry is cooked to an internal temperature of 74°C / 165°F (juices run clear, no pink remaining) before serving.
